why_ai: Members pay for community, in-person gatherings and collective advocacy, which AI does not substitute.
why_clarity: Member value and dues ROI are hard to define, and retention drift shows only at renewal.
why_digital: Mix of in-person conferences and lobbying with digital newsletters, directories and dues.

why_ai: Accountable underwriters price unusual occupational populations, though rating itself is automatable.
why_clarity: Programmes are priced by actuarial method each renewal, with losses emerging over years.
why_digital: Loss and eligibility data in, programme pricing and reports out.

why_ai: Boards hire trusted contract staff, but membership, events and finance admin automate steadily.
why_clarity: Recurring board, membership and fiscal cycles follow established procedures.
why_digital: Mostly screen-based administration, plus board meetings and events in person.

why_ai: Renewal analytics and engagement scoring are standard ML over membership records.
why_clarity: Renewal and engagement metrics are defined, with results visible each renewal cycle.
why_digital: Membership records in, analytics and benchmarks delivered in software.

why_ai: Annual sector surveys are analysis AI accelerates; the association brand carries the credibility.
why_clarity: Annual surveys follow fixed methods, with forecasts verified only later.
why_digital: Member submissions in, benchmark reports published online.

why_digital: Item and survey data in, exams delivered online or at test centres.

why_clarity: The annual event repeats, but attendee and exhibitor ROI are loosely measured.
why_digital: Registrations and proposals are digital, but value is delivered at a physical venue.

why_ai: Apprenticeship training, safety certification and labour relations depend on local in-person trust.

why_ai: District matching, contact generation and campaign analytics are software and ML tasks.
why_clarity: Contacts are counted easily, but whether advocacy moved a vote is hard to establish.

why_ai: Bill tracking, issue tagging and alerting are exactly what LLM pipelines automate.

why_ai: Street cleaning, security and community relations are physical, local and quasi-governmental.

why_ai: Employers trust the credential brand, though recertification and verification are rule-based admin.
why_clarity: Eligibility, exams, CE tracking and recertification follow codified rules at volume.

why_ai: Preparers sign public returns and attorneys defend examinations, though 990 preparation automates.

why_ai: Lobbying runs on personal relationships with legislators and adversarial political judgment.
why_clarity: Tracking and PAC compliance are rule-based, but advocacy impact is hard to measure.

why_ai: Treasurers carry personal liability for filings, though contribution checks and reports automate.

why_digital: Contribution records in, disclosure filings submitted electronically.

why_ai: Tracking and summarising regulatory activity is core LLM work, with interpretation partly protected.

why_digital: Agency publications in, analysis and alerts delivered online.

why_ai: Ballot and comment administration automates, while consensus itself stays with human committees.
